correctness_comparator: exact generated token IDs versus fresh NONE reference; short-answer arithmetic/capital/translation checks before latency
performance_condition: collect latency only for a profile that starts and passes correctness; retain failures without reporting them as speedups
tpot_definition: (SSE DONE timestamp - first nonempty content timestamp) / 511
summary: median of three measured samples; startup, compilation, graph capture, warmup and profiler excluded
overlay_scope: same partial native BF16 overlay as previous performance run; no full PR 622 wheel claim
